mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CHATROOM_S WHERE chatroom_sq = #{chatroomSq} AND chatroom_type = 'COUNSELOR'

SELECT chatroom_sq AS chatroomSq, user_sq AS userSq, last_message AS lastMessage, last_message_at AS lastMessageAt, chatroom_type AS chatroomType, chatroom_created_at AS chatroomCreatedAt
FROM TBL_CHATROOM_S WHERE user_sq = #{userSq} ORDER By last_message_at DESC
